item.title: [Ada Derana Biz English] Sri Lanka’s High Grown Tea Output Plunges to 34-Year Low Amid Heavy August Rains
item.description:
High Grown tea production in Sri Lanka dropped to its lowest monthly level in 34 years during August 2026, falling to 3.1 million kilograms due to persistent overcast skies and excessive rainfall.
Preliminary figures released by the Sri Lanka Tea Board and reported by Asia Siyaka Commodities PLC confirm that August’s High Grown output is the lowest recorded in any single month since the landmark El Niño year of 1992.
